Alt Tags & Media — WCAG 1.1.1 Non-text Content (Level A)
Audit page 7 — image and media fixes
Image #1 — Prosano Benefits Graphic
alt="Prosano Health benefits graphic showing 37% fewer emergency room visits, 7% fewer acute hospital admissions, and 35% fewer specialist visits, and a guaranteed 5% premium discount"

Informative — alt must convey the statistical data.

Image #2 — Decorative Photo
alt=""

Decorative — empty alt tells screen readers to skip it. Do not omit the attribute entirely.

Video — Prosano Real Stories (Vimeo)
<section role="region" aria-label="Prosano Real Stories: Tom C.C." aria-describedby="vimeo-desc"> <p id="vimeo-desc">...</p> <iframe src="https://player.vimeo.com/..." title="Prosano Real Stories: Tom C.C."> </iframe> </section>

Section aria-label and iframe title both required.

Image #4 — BCBS Arizona Logo
alt="Blue Cross Blue Shield of Arizona logo"

Identifies the organization and image type.

Skip to Content

Key bindings

TabNavigate interactive elements — left to right, top to bottom.
Shift+TabNavigate back to previous element.
EnterActivate buttons or links, including inside dropdowns.
EscClose modals or dropdown menus.
↑↓←→Navigate dropdown items, sliders, radio groups.
SpaceCheck/uncheck checkboxes; activate dropdowns and buttons.
Ctrl+LBrowser address bar (reference).
